cpmplus.w3animtools.err.noAnimation: Select an animation first (Animations panel, in Animate mode).
cpmplus.w3animtools.err.selectPart: Select a part first (click it in the outliner).
cpmplus.w3animtools.err.noChannels: Tick at least one channel (Rotation, Position or Size).
cpmplus.w3animtools.warn.formulaSkipped: %s keyframe(s) with a formula (molang) were left as they were: formulas are never changed.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.reverse.desc: The whole animation plays backwards (every part, from 0 to the end)
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.reverse.empty: The animation "%s" has no keyframes to reverse.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.reverse.mixedSte: Some parts mix "step" keyframes with other ones: check that it looks the way you wanted.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.reverse.formula: %s keyframe(s) with a formula (molang) moved in time, but the formula stays the same.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.speed.desc: Makes the animation faster or slower. Keeps the same file size; untick "adjust snapping" for a lighter file
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.speed.hint: Tip: changing the speed keeps the same file size; untick "adjust snapping" for a lighter file.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.smooth.desc: Every keyframe of the selected animation becomes smooth (curve). Visibility stays a step
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.linear.desc: Every keyframe of the selected animation becomes straight (straight line between them). Visibility stays a step
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.smooth.nothing: Nothing changed: the animation was already smooth.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.linear.nothing: Nothing changed: the animation was already straight.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.onion.desc: Shows the pose before and after over the model, transparent, to help you animate
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.trail.desc: Shows a line with the path the selected part takes during the animation
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.trail_lock: Lock the trail on this part
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.trail_lock.desc: The trail keeps showing this part even when you select another one
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.mirror.desc: What you do on a part of one side is copied, mirrored, to the part on the other side (left/right, also in Portuguese)
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.missing: This Blockbench does not have this feature. Update Blockbench to use it.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.notNow: This is not available right now: open Animate mode and select an animation (and a part, when the feature needs one).
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.menu.desc: Makes the parts move more or less in the selected animation (0% to 300%)
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.title: Exaggerate or soften movement
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.intro: Changes how much the parts move in the animation "%s", without changing the timing.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.intro2: 100% = the same, 200% = moves twice as much, 50% = moves half as much, 0% = stays still in the normal pose. Colour and visibility do not change.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.onlySel.desc: Changes only the keyframes selected in the timeline
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.preview: Show on the model while adjusting
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.noSelectedKeys: No keyframe is selected in the timeline. Select the stretch or untick "Only the selected stretch".
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.over360: Note: a rotation goes past 360 degrees (%s). It works, but check that this is what you want.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.menu.desc: Creates a keyframe on every animated part at the current time, keeping the pose shown now
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.title: Mark pose here
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.intro: Creates keyframes at %s on every part that already moves, with the pose shown now (the movement does not change). Good to "hold" the pose before changing another part.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.empty.desc: Also creates rotation, position and size keyframes on animated parts that do not use that channel yet
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.color.desc: Also marks the colour, only on parts with Recolor or coloured cubes that already change colour
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.outside: The timeline cursor is after the end of the animation. Move the cursor back inside the animation.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.nothing: Nothing to mark: the animated parts already have a keyframe at this time.
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.menu.desc: Creates the pose at the current time by blending the previous and the next key (or pulling toward rest), on many parts at once, with a live preview.
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.title: In-between pose
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.intro: Creates or adjusts the pose at %s in the animation '%s'. Only rotation, position and scale change (never colour or visibility).
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.parts.all: Parts: every part that moves in this animation (nothing selected).
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.mode.tween: Between the previous and the next pose
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.amount.desc: -100 = same as the previous key, 0 = halfway, +100 = same as the next one. Beyond ±100 it overshoots (up to 150). In a loop, the last key comes before the first one.
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.rest.desc: 0 = the pose now, 100 = rest (no rotation, no offset, normal size). Above 100 goes past rest; negative pushes away (exaggerates).
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.children.desc: E.g. you selected the wing: the feathers inside it are included too.
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.preview: Show it on the model while I adjust
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.summary: %s key(s) will be created or adjusted.
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.noNeighbor: %s channel(s) without a key before or after (non-looping animation) were left as they were.
cpmplus.w3animtools.tween.nothing: Nothing to change: the chosen parts have no keys in these channels (or no key before and after).
cpmplus.w3animtools.pose.copy.desc: Stores the current pose of the selected parts and everything inside them (nothing selected = the whole model). Like CPM's "Copy Part Pose", for many parts at once.
cpmplus.w3animtools.pose.paste.desc: Pastes the copied pose at the current time (any animation, any time). If you copied ONE part and selected ANOTHER, it goes onto that one and the parts inside it.
cpmplus.w3animtools.pose.pasteMirror: Paste pose on the other side (mirrored)
cpmplus.w3animtools.pose.pasteMirror.des: Pastes the copied pose onto the parts of the other side (left <-> right), mirrored. Parts without a side (head, tail) are mirrored in place.
cpmplus.w3animtools.pose.mirror.desc: Mirrors the current pose of the selected parts. A part and its partner both selected swap sides; a part alone is mirrored in place (like CPM's "Mirror Part Pose").
cpmplus.w3animtools.pose.pastedMirror: Mirrored pose pasted on %s part(s) at %s
cpmplus.w3animtools.pose.mirrored: Pose mirrored: %s part(s) swapped sides, %s mirrored in place
cpmplus.w3animtools.pose.nothing: Nothing changed: these parts have no movement to copy.
cpmplus.w3animtools.pose.err.empty: Copy a pose first (Copy parts pose).
cpmplus.w3animtools.pose.warn.missing: %s part(s) left out: no matching part found (or two would go to the same place).
cpmplus.w3animtools.pose.warn.guess: %s part(s) went to the most likely partner (similar names, check them).
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.menu.desc: Tails, ears, hair, capes... swing on their own following the animation (an additive layer that plays together in game).
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.title: Physics: follow the movement
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.intro: Creates the layer '%s' (additive), which plays together with '%s' in game and makes the chosen parts swing with a delay: tail, ears, hair, cape, antenna... The original animation does not change. Running it again updates the layer.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.update: The layer already exists: OK updates it.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.partsFromLay: Parts of the current layer: %s (to change them, select other parts before opening).
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.floppy.desc: Floppier = takes longer to follow and lags more. Stiffer = follows almost together.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.bounce.desc: 0 = settles without overshooting. High = swings back and forth several times before stopping.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.weight.desc: Pulls the tips down, like gravity.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.maxAngle.des: How far each part may leave the animation's pose, at most.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.tipLoose.des: The last parts of a chain (the tail tip) are floppier than the first ones.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.mix.desc: 100 = the simulation's result. Less = subtler; more = exaggerated.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.force.walk: Walking: a light wind from the front pushes the tips back.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.force.sneakW: Sneaking: a very light wind from the front.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.force.run: Running: a strong wind from the front pushes the tips back.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.force.creati: Creative flying: wind from the front pushes the tips back.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.force.retroS: Swimming (old upright style): water from the front pushes back.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.force.ride: Riding: a light wind from the front.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.force.fall: Falling: the air pushes the tips up.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.force.elytra: Elytra flying: the body lies flat and the wind comes from the head, pushing the tips toward the feet.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.force.swim: Swimming: the body lies flat and the water comes from the head, pushing the tips toward the feet.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.force.crawl: Crawling: body flat, a light push toward the feet.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.force.jump: Jump: a jolt downwards at the start that settles.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.children.des: On: each chosen part and everything inside it becomes a chain (a tail of 3 parts = 3 links that whip). Off: only the chosen parts.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.preview: Show the physics on the model
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.preview.desc: Turn it off and on to compare with and without physics. Nothing is saved before OK.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.play: Play the animation while I adjust
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.vanillaNote: The physics only follows this animation's movement. Minecraft's own swing (arms and legs while walking, the head looking around) is not included.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.summary: %s part(s) swinging · %s frames · largest swing %s° · settled after %s cycle(s).
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.done: Layer '%s' ready: %s part(s), %s frames. It plays together with the original in game.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.err.select: Select the parts that will swing in the outliner (for example the first part of the tail) and open it again.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.err.onlyRoot: The main body parts (head, body, arms, legs) do not swing with physics. Select parts INSIDE them (tail, ear, hair...).
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.err.isLayer: '%s' is already a physics layer. Select the original animation.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.err.staged: '%s' is an entry / exit animation (p:, c:, g:). Use physics on the main animation.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.err.value: '%s' is driven by a value (slider or game value), not by time: physics does not apply.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.err.nothing: Nothing swings: the animation does not move these parts or what holds them. Animate the body or the tail first, raise Weight or turn on 'Add the game's movement'.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.warn.roots: %s main body part(s) were left out (only the parts inside them swing).
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.warn.empty: %s part(s) without a block or a tip (pivot in the middle): they only pass the movement on.
cpmplus.w3animtools.physics.warn.notSett: The swing did not fully settle (still changes %s° per cycle): the loop seam was smoothed. Less Bounce settles faster.
cpmplus.w3animtools.reladj.menu.desc: Adds the same change to every key of the parts (the whole pose shifts, the motion stays the same), in one or many animations.
cpmplus.w3animtools.reladj.title: Relative adjust
cpmplus.w3animtools.reladj.intro: Adds the SAME change to every key of the chosen parts: the whole pose shifts and the motion stays the same. Example: lower the tail 10° in the whole animation, or in every animation at once.
cpmplus.w3animtools.reladj.parts.all: Nothing selected: every animated part in '%s'.
cpmplus.w3animtools.reladj.scope.before: From the start to the playhead
cpmplus.w3animtools.reladj.falloff.desc: Outside the range the change fades out over this time, without a step.
cpmplus.w3animtools.reladj.anims.all: In every animation that moves these parts (%s)
cpmplus.w3animtools.reladj.done: %s key(s) adjusted in %s animation(s). One Ctrl+Z undoes it all.
cpmplus.w3animtools.reladj.nothing: Nothing changed: these parts have no keys in that channel and range.
cpmplus.w3animtools.reladj.err.noChange: Type a change (rotate, move, or a size other than 100%).
cpmplus.w3animtools.reladj.warn.noKeys: %s channel(s) without keys were left out (adding there would change what the animation does).
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.menu.edit.desc: An additive layer on top of the animation to fix it without touching the original keys. In game it plays together.
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.menu.merge: Correction layer: merge into the animation...
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.created: Layer '%s' created and selected: key your corrections in it (the original keeps playing). Ctrl+Alt+Shift+A goes back to the original.
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.opened: Editing '%s' (the original keeps playing). Ctrl+Alt+Shift+A goes back to the original.
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.back: Back to '%s' (the correction layer keeps playing).
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.strength.title: Correction layer strength
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.strength.intro: Scales everything the layer '%s' does (100% = as it is, 0% = nothing).
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.merge.title: Merge correction layer
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.merge.intro: Adds the layer '%s' into the keys of '%s' (rotate and move add, size multiplies) and deletes the layer. One Ctrl+Z undoes it all.
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.merge.warn.newP: %s channel(s) were not animated in the original: they become new keys there.
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.merge.warn.igno: %s part(s) of the layer have visibility or colour keys: those are not merged.
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.merge.warn.mola: %s formula key(s) in the original become numbers (the value at each moment).
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.err.noLayer: '%s' has no correction layer. Use 'Correction layer: create / edit' first.
cpmplus.w3animtools.corr.err.noOriginal: Could not find the original animation of '%s' (renamed?).
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.menu.desc: Creates the entry (plays once before the loop) and exit (plays once after) animations CPM uses, so the pose does not start or end with a jump.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.title: Smooth entry and exit
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.intro: CPM does not blend one pose into another: the switch is a hard cut. This creates CPM's own entry and exit animations named '%s' (linked to %s animation(s)): the entry plays once before the loop starts, the exit plays once when the pose ends.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.entry.desc: Goes from the rest pose (or the start of another animation) to the first pose of the loop.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.exit.desc: Goes from the first pose of the loop back to rest (or to the start of another animation).
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.replaces: One already exists: it will be replaced.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.mustFinish.des: The loop finishes its current cycle before the exit plays, so the exit starts from the right pose (turns on CPM's 'must finish').
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.done: Entry/exit '%s' ready. In game it plays by itself before/after the loop.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.why.noType: '%s' has no CPM type (open the animation properties and pick the pose).
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.why.staged: '%s' already is an entry / exit animation.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.why.value: '%s' is driven by a value (slider or game value): CPM does not use entry / exit there.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.why.global: The 'Global' pose always plays: it has no entry or exit.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.why.loop: '%s' must be set to Loop (in 'Once' the exporter already makes its own entry).
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.err.nothing: Tick the entry, the exit or both.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.err.link: Could not link '%s' to a CPM entry / exit name.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.err.tooShort: The duration must be at least 1 frame (%s s).
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.err.noTracks: '%s' does not move anything: nothing to smooth.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.warn.notClosed: The loop does not close (the end differs from the start): the exit may start with a jump. Use 'Close the loop' first.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.warn.noMustFin: Without 'finish the cycle', the exit starts wherever the loop was: it may jump.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.warn.companion: %s '#' layer(s) of this custom pose do not wait for the entry (CPM links custom poses by the full name).
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.report.title: Pose cut report
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.report.intro: When the game switches poses (standing → walking, walking → running...), CPM cuts hard. These are the parts that jump the most in those switches (worst case = switching at the worst moment of the loop).
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.report.how: How to fix: make the poses more alike (Relative adjust), start the second animation close to where the first one usually is, or create a smooth entry for it.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.report.none: No big jumps between the poses (standing, walking, running, sneaking...).
cpmplus.w3animtools.trans.warn.export: %s pose switch(es) with a big jump. The biggest: '%s' from %s to %s (%s). See CPM+ > Animation > Pose cut report.
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.menu.desc: Speed, intensity, swap the part, copy or delete a part's track in many animations at once (one Ctrl+Z undoes it all).
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.title: Edit keys in many animations
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.intro: Does the same operation on the keys of every ticked animation at once. One Ctrl+Z undoes it all.
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.op.retarget: Swap the part (one part's keys go to another)
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.op.copy: Copy a part's track from this animation to the others
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.factor.desc: Speed: 50% = half the duration (2x faster), 200% = twice as long. Intensity: 50% = half the movement, 150% = 1.5x.
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.stretch.desc: The copied track fills the whole destination animation, even if it is shorter or longer.
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.done: %s key(s) changed in %s animation(s). One Ctrl+Z undoes it all.
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.nothing: Nothing changed: no keys in those animations / parts.
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.err.noTarget: Pick the destination part (different from the source part).
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.warn.tooLong: %s animation(s) go past 32.7 s, CPM's limit.
cpmplus.w3animtools.batch.undo.retarget: Swap the part in many animations
cpmplus.w3animtools.trail.menu.desc: Draws the path the TIP of each selected part makes in the animation (Blockbench's own trail only follows the pivot). Colour = speed (blue slow, red fast); dot = a frame that goes to the game; click a dot to jump to it.
cpmplus.w3animtools.trail.on: Tip trails on: select the parts (Animate mode).
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.menu.desc: Looks for what usually looks bad in game: 1-frame spikes, a leftover step key, a jump/jolt at the loop seam, a gesture that does not return to rest, robotic movement and sides that are too alike.
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.title: Check the movement
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.intro: %s point(s) to check (red = will show in game, yellow = likely, blue = style tip). The buttons go to the moment and select the part.
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.none: Nothing odd found in the movement.
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.spike: 1-frame spike: the key is %s away from its neighbours (which are close together). Intended?
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.step: A step key among smooth keys: this key is 'Step' and the others are not (the movement jumps).
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.seamJump: The end of the loop does not meet the start (off by %s): it jumps every cycle. Use 'Close the loop'.
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.seamJolt: The loop closes but the speed changes suddenly at the seam (a jolt every cycle). Smooth the first/last keys.
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.startRest: The gesture starts away from rest (%s): it jumps when it starts.
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.endRest: The gesture ends away from rest (%s): it jumps when it ends.
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.robotic: %s channel(s) with only straight (Linear) keys that change direction: the movement stops dead at every key (robotic). Try 'Make everything smooth' or Smooth movement.
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.twins: '%s' and '%s' do exactly the same at the same time: it looks mechanical. Delay one side a few frames (Delay / advance movement).
cpmplus.w3animtools.emote.menu.desc: Turns an Emotecraft/PlayerAnimator emote .json into a CPM gesture: easings, loop with entry, whole body and bends (elbow/knee from 'Bend limb').
cpmplus.w3animtools.emote.done: Emote imported as the gesture '%s'. Check it in the Animate mode (and in game from the gesture button).
cpmplus.w3animtools.emote.err.json: The file is not valid JSON.
cpmplus.w3animtools.emote.err.notEmote: This JSON is not an Emotecraft emote ('emote' is missing). For GeckoLib/Bedrock animations use 'Import Bedrock/GeckoLib animation'.
cpmplus.w3animtools.emote.err.nothing: The emote moves no body part the model has.
cpmplus.w3animtools.emote.warn.bends: %s part(s) bend in the emote but the model has no elbow/knee: the bends were left out. Use 'Bend limb' and import again.
cpmplus.w3animtools.emote.warn.body: The emote moves the whole player: the movement was spread over the body parts (in CPM they are separate). Check it in game.
cpmplus.w3animtools.clip.menu.desc: Puts another animation inside this one at the playhead: N times, faster/slower, reversed, pushing the rest and with soft edges.
cpmplus.w3animtools.clip.title: Insert clip
cpmplus.w3animtools.clip.intro: Inserts another animation into '%s' from %s s (the playhead).
cpmplus.w3animtools.clip.ripple.desc: On: what came after the playhead moves forward and the animation gets longer. Off: the clip replaces that stretch.
cpmplus.w3animtools.clip.err.same: Pick another animation as the clip (not this one).
cpmplus.w3animtools.clip.err.empty: '%s' has no keys (or no duration) to insert.
cpmplus.w3animtools.clip.err.noClips: There is no other animation to use as a clip.
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.stepped.menu.de: The viewport holds every pose until the next key, to check the key poses without the in-betweens. Preview only: the animation and the game do not change.
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.silhouette.menu: Draws the whole model dark to read the pose by its outline. Viewport only.
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.cycle.menu: Click again picks the part behind
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.cycle.menu.desc: A second click on the same spot selects the next part under the mouse (the one behind), and so on.
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.tangents.menu.d: Turns the keys (the selected ones, or every key of the selected parts) into smooth curves that never go past the neighbours: peaks and valleys stay flat.
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.tangents.done: %s key(s) with smooth curves that never overshoot.
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.tangents.nothin: No keys to adjust (select keys or parts with 2+ keys).
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.squash.title: Stretch / squash
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.squash.intro: Creates a size key at %s s on the selected parts: stretches one axis and thins the other two just enough, so the part does not get bigger or smaller.
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.pivot.title: Temporary pivot
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.pivot.intro: Rotates the selected parts around another part's pivot without changing any pivot: rotation and position keys at %s s.
cpmplus.w3animtools.aids.pivot.err.noPiv: Pick the part whose pivot is the centre of the turn.
cpmplus.w3animtools.takes.menu.desc: Keeps versions of the animation to try other ideas and go back or mix later. They do not go to the game.
cpmplus.w3animtools.takes.title: Takes
cpmplus.w3animtools.takes.intro: Takes of '%s': copies kept in the project (they do not go to the game). Save, change anything, then restore or mix.
cpmplus.w3animtools.takes.name: Take name
cpmplus.w3animtools.takes.saveLabel: Keep it as it is now
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.menu: New animation from what you want...
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.menu.desc: Pick the goal (tail always moving, change the walk, emote, toggle, sit, follow the look) and the animation starts with the right type, loop and additive.
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.title: New animation from what you want
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.intro: Pick what you want to make: the animation is created with the right CPM type, loop and 'additive'. Then just animate.
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.name: Name (optional)
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.always: Something moving all the time (tail, ear, breathing)
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.always.name: always
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.always.when: Plays ALWAYS, in any situation (Global pose), adding to everything else. Great for a swaying tail or breathing.
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.walkStyle: Decorate the walk (adds to Minecraft's swing)
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.walkStyle.whe: Plays while walking. Additive: arms and legs keep swinging with Minecraft's steps and what you animate adds on top (animate parts that are not arms/legs, or the body).
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.walkReplace: Replace the whole walk (replaces Minecraft's swing)
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.walkReplace.w: Plays while walking and REPLACES Minecraft's swing on the parts you animate. The step keeps the same pace at any speed. Tip: 'Generate walk (2 or 4 legs)' makes the cycle for you.
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.runStyle.name: running
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.runStyle.when: Plays while running, adding to Minecraft's swing.
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.gesture: Emote / gesture (button in the gesture wheel)
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.gesture.name: gesture
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.gesture.when: Plays once when you press the button in CPM's gesture wheel. Not additive: the gesture's pose drives the parts you animate.
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.toggle.name: toggle
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.toggle.when: A button that turns on and off; while on, it loops on top of everything.
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.pose.name: sit
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.pose.when: A pose picked in CPM's pose menu; it stays until you change it. Not additive: the pose drives.
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.look: Parts that follow where the head looks
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.look.name: follow the look
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.look.when: Driven by the head turn (left/right): the SELECTED parts turn from 45° one way to 45° the other. Select the parts first.
cpmplus.w3animtools.recipe.err.lookParts: Select the parts that will follow the look (e.g. eyes, ears) in the outliner and open it again.
cpmplus.w3animtools.gait.menu.desc: Creates a ready walk or run cycle: alternating legs, opposite arms (or a 4-leg trot), bending knees/elbows and the body going up and down.
cpmplus.w3animtools.gait.title: Generate walk / run
cpmplus.w3animtools.gait.intro: Creates a looping walk (or run) animation that replaces Minecraft's swing on the legs and arms.
cpmplus.w3animtools.gait.knees.desc: Only works when the limb has an elbow/knee ('Bend limb').
cpmplus.w3animtools.gait.note: CPM plays on its own clock: the step always has the same pace, even when walking slowly. That is how knees/elbows stay in step.
cpmplus.w3animtools.gait.done: Animation '%s' created. Adjust it as you like (or use Exaggerate / Relative adjust).
cpmplus.w3animtools.gait.err.noLegs: Could not find the legs (pick the parts in the lists).
cpmplus.w3animtools.check.walkSync: '%s' (inside '%s') moves on CPM's clock but the leg/arm swings with Minecraft's steps: they drift apart (the foot slides, the knee bends at the wrong moment). Use 'Generate walk' or make the animation non-additive.
cpmplus.w3animtools.face.menu.desc: Expressions as toggle buttons, a mouth that opens while talking (voice chat) and eyes that follow where the head looks.
cpmplus.w3animtools.face.title: Face kit
cpmplus.w3animtools.face.intro: Build the face in groups (one group per expression, an open-mouth group, the pupils) and pick them below. Each becomes a ready animation.
cpmplus.w3animtools.face.expr.desc: Each becomes a toggle button that shows that face and hides the others.
cpmplus.w3animtools.face.mouth.desc: Shows when the player talks in voice chat (CPM's 'speaking' pose).
cpmplus.w3animtools.face.eyes: Pupils / eyes that follow the look
cpmplus.w3animtools.face.eyes.desc: They slide sideways and up/down as the head turns.
cpmplus.w3animtools.face.err.nothing: Pick at least one expression, the mouth or the eyes.
cpmplus.w3animtools.testcpm.menu: Test in the CPM editor (Test tab)
cpmplus.w3animtools.testcpm.menu.desc: Opens the project in the CPM editor straight in Animation > Test, with Minecraft's animations on and this animation picked: see how it looks in game.
cpmplus.w3animtools.testcpm.guide: Opening in the CPM editor: Animation tab > Test, with '%s' picked and Minecraft's animations on.
cpmplus.w3animtools.testcpm.guideLayer: Opening in the CPM editor: in Animation > Test, turn the layer/slider on with the layers button.
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.menu: Help: I saw this in a video...
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.menu.desc: CPM videos use CPM's own editor: this says where each thing is in Blockbench + CPM+.
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.title: I saw this in a video
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.intro: Almost every CPM tutorial is recorded in CPM's own editor. Here is where each thing is in Blockbench with CPM+.
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.add.here: Animations panel > + (or CPM+ > Animation > New animation from what you want, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N).
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.type.here: Right-click the animation > Properties: the CPM type field.
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.additive.here: Properties > Additive. On: adds to Minecraft; off: replaces it (the head stops following the mouse). See CPM+ > Animation > X-ray.
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.frames.here: Keys on Blockbench's timeline (move the part with the playhead in place). CPM+ turns them into frames on export.
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.interp.here: Click the key: Linear / Smooth (Catmull-Rom) / Bezier / Step.
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.test.here: CPM+ > Animation > Test in the CPM editor (opens it there).
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.hide.seen: Hide/show a part in the animation
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.button.seen: Gesture name in the wheel / several animations on one button
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.button.here: The name before # is the button: 'Dance#body' and 'Dance#head' play together on the 'Dance' button.
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.export.here: CPM+ > Take it to the game (Ctrl+Alt+J).
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.duplicate.here: Right-click > Duplicate: the CPM settings come along (check them in Properties).
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.loop.here: Properties > Loop. Poses always repeat in game; 'once' becomes an automatic entry.
cpmplus.w3animtools.video.value.here: Type 'Value layer' or poses like Health/Look: the value moves along the timeline (start = 0, end = 100%).
